description: An AI-powered sales CRM combining calling, email, SMS, pipeline management, and autonomous AI agents into a single platform.
auth_notes: API keys use HTTP Basic Auth (with key as username and empty password) for scripts/internal use; OAuth 2.0 is used for user-facing integrations and public apps.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a 14-day free trial self-serve without a credit card to access API keys and MCP features, but ongoing API and MCP access require a paid plan.
api_notes: Comprehensive REST API covering leads, contacts, opportunities, tasks, activities (calls, emails, SMS, meetings), webhooks, reporting, custom fields/objects, and CRM configurations.
mcp_notes: Close publishes an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server enabling AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, and VS Code to connect directly to Close data.
rationale: Close provides a broad REST API and an official MCP server with self-serve signup, but continuous usage requires a paid subscription following the 14-day trial.

evidence.note: Documents HTTP Basic authentication with API keys and OAuth 2.0 support.
Details a 14-day free trial self-serve option and paid subscription tiers (Solo, Essentials, Growth, Scale) required for ongoing API/MCP access.
Outlines the full REST API endpoint surface covering CRM objects, activities, webhooks, and custom data.
Confirms the official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provided for AI agents.
